channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US-Iran talks continue, but ‘deal unlikely’ before midterm elections
item.description: The US and Iran are talking through mediators, but there are major differences over what a deal should look like.

item.title: Thousands of drivers strike in the Philippines over rising fuel prices
item.description: Transport workers blame US-Israel war on Iran for rising fuel prices as government offers free rides for commuters.

item.title: Satellite images show Gaza in ruins three years into Israel’s genocidal war
item.description: Google Maps images show scale of Israel's destruction of Gaza, where more than 74,000 Palestinians have been killed.

item.title: Israeli forces kill Hamas commander Izz al-Din al-Beik in Gaza attack
item.description: Head of Hamas's armed wing in northern Gaza killed in ⁠an Israeli strike on an apartment building in Gaza City.

item.title: AFCON qualifiers: Wissa guides DR Congo to win, Tunisia held by Botswana
item.description: Democratic Republic of the Congo secure their second straight win in Group E, with striker Yoanne Wissa scoring again.

item.title: Public transport drivers strike in Manila over soaring fuel prices
item.description: Public transport drivers in Manila begin a three-day strike over soaring fuel prices.

item.title: Rubio, Saudi Arabia’s foreign minister hold talks on Yemen, Hormuz Strait
item.description: Top US and Saudi diplomats discuss cooperation on security challenges, including hostilities with Yemen's Houthis.

item.title: Russia pounds Ukraine’s Kyiv after deadly strike on Academy of Sciences
item.description: Footage of attack on Academy shows people leaning out of windows as bright flames engulf part of the historic building.

item.title: Iran’s Araghchi meets Qatari mediators as US calls for nuclear talks
item.description: Tehran awaits reply on Hormuz plan as a US official says there will be no deal unless nuclear issues are addressed.
